title: Chapter 168 Mission To South Korea
content:
Chapter 168 Mission To South Korea

"You mean, the Qin Kingdom has already... the one who can unify the world has become this Yu Kingdom!" Hearing Donghuang's explanation, Moon God was even more surprised, and his calm face changed a little.

"Will the Yu Kingdom be able to unify the world? I'm not sure, but the Qin Kingdom, judging from their current fate, is almost impossible. If they stay in the Qin Kingdom, it will be difficult for the Yin-Yang Family's power to expand greatly." , it’s better to take refuge in this Yuguo, which seems to be full of mist and can’t be seen through, and fight for that chance of survival!” This word that can affect the fate of the Yinyang family came from Donghuang’s mouth, but no one didn’t believe it. , They have always believed that the Eastern Emperor is the most powerful and mysterious person in the world.

"Is that so? Then Your Excellency Dong Huang, Luna will arrange for the evacuation and send people to Yuguo to make contact. I believe that King Jing, who has had contact with my Yinyang family, is a good breakthrough!" Luna thought After thinking about it, he found that the best way to contact an extremely strange country was Prince Jing, who had killed two elders of his Yin-Yang family.

"Well, you have a good idea, so do you know where you are tonight?" Dong Huang Tai nodded, also agreeing with the decision of Moon God.

"According to the news from the spies of the Yin-Yang family in various places, this King Jing, after signing the covenant with King Yan, has become an envoy of the imperial kingdom to communicate with other countries, and hastened to tour around the world! He has already visited Zhao at this moment. China, is rushing to South Korea!" Luna said the news he got.

"Since that's the case, then you should go there yourself and see what kind of existence this bright-faced person introduced by Yuguo is!" After saying this sentence, Donghuang Taiyi suddenly disappeared from the spot , the empty Luosheng Hall left only the lonely figure of Luna.

"Yi Shu, is his power really that powerful? The original fate of the whole world has changed with his appearance!" Seeing the disappearing figure of the Eastern Emperor, Luna looked up at the stars in the sky, sighed.

…………

South Korea, a small city in the north of here at the moment, belongs to the border between South Korea and North Korea. It is usually stationed with heavy troops and serves as a border town for trade between the two countries.

The city is usually crowded with people, with tens of thousands of permanent residents and 40,000 to 50,000 floating population. It was originally an extremely prosperous place, but often at night, it was also late at night and the sky was shaking, making it difficult to rest in peace.

But at this time, the whole city was put under martial law by couples of soldiers. One by one, merchants, hawkers, and travelers were all driven to the inn or their respective rooms and were not allowed to come out.

"Master City Guard, the city is already ready, and all aspects of the reception are about to be completed, but I don't know when the big man we are going to welcome will come? Who is he?" The city lord of this small city stood beside him. Looking at a general, he was asking the city lord.

"It's okay to tell you, this time the person who came here is a big man, with a distinguished status, almost no less than my king in Korea!" The city lord showed off a little complacently, obviously, to be able to get this kind of news, and to be able to welcome such a big man, he Also feel a little proud.

"Oh, he can stand shoulder to shoulder with the king of South Korea. Who is he? With such a noble status, is he the king of the other six countries?" Wang, will you come to visit Korea?

Think about it but don't really believe it. How can the king of each country be honored? It is related to the rise and fall of a country, how can they leave their country lightly and put themselves in danger!

"You idiot, of course the kings of the other six countries can't easily leave their countries, but you forgot that in the north of the world, a powerful country has risen, and it is easy to beat the country of Yan to the ground. You know In terms of strength, Yan Guo can be twice as strong as South Korea!" Seeing himself as a subordinate, he actually suspects that he is lying? The city lord couldn't help being annoyed.

"Well, is it that the city lord is talking about the sudden appearance of Yuguo? But even if it is this Yuguo, their king doesn't seem to go abroad easily!" Hearing the city lord's prompt, the general still didn't understand.

"You are such an idiot. The supreme ruler of their country, I heard that they are not called kings like us, but are respected as emperors. This is an incomparably noble title. And this time they will lead an army of 300,000 to attack His Royal Highness Prince Jing who has taken over half of the territory of the Yan Kingdom!" The city lord was really annoyed by this general who usually seemed to be his right-hand man.

"Emperor, are they so arrogant? You know, more than ten years ago, Qin State and Qi State were called one emperor, but they were pressured by other countries and had to cancel it. How dare he do this? He added the title of emperor and the title of emperor at the same time!" The general was really taken aback by the news, and his mouth trembled a little.

"Hey, how do we little people understand what these people think? But I heard that this imperial country is tens of thousands of miles away from him, which is larger than Chu State. There are millions of warriors who can fight well. There are even more fighters in Qin, he is called an emperor, although the countries in the world are not convinced, but he has to admit that he barely has this strength!" The city lord sighed, obviously thinking of the current situation in South Korea, although he was called As the king, but the strength is even weaker than before South Korea became the king.

"Besides, this Imperial Kingdom is different from all other countries in the world. He was not entrusted by Emperor Zhou. Calling him an emperor is fundamentally different from calling him an emperor in the seven kingdoms of the world!"

"Yes, after all, they are barbarians from the north, and of course they cannot be compared with our country of etiquette in the Central Plains!" As the general spoke, he despised Yu Guo, but was proud of it.

Hearing his subordinate's words, the city lord's expression changed, and his left hand slammed down on his head, and the general who hammered him screamed in pain.

"My lord, why are you beating your subordinates!" The general had tears in his eyes, full of grievances.

"You don't know how to advance or retreat, can you say things like barbarians? They are a big country that defeated Yan, and their strength is even stronger than that of Qin. To put it bluntly, if they send a partial army If you can destroy my Korea, even the king of my country and the big men have to deal with it carefully. How can a small person like you despise it? You better pay attention to your words, otherwise, it will bring disaster to my Korea, and the first one will not be spared What's yours is mine!" The city lord said these words in anger.

"Yes, what my lord taught me is that the villain will never dare to do it again." The general turned pale when he heard his city lord's lesson, and quickly replied.
